name: Police Bank

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Police Bank Target Market Determination — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025 (PBL21-V1-31102025)
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: 'Lender's Mortgage Insurance (LMI) may be required and a premium charged for this home loan if the Loan to Value Ratio (LVR) exceeds 80%.' The Police Bank home loans page states the same: maximum 80% LVR for standard loans, above which LMI is required, with the exception of the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Derived from the stated deposit requirement: the product is designed for borrowers who 'Have a minimum of 5% deposit for owner occupied or 10% for investment to contribute towards their purchase, accepting Lenders Mortgage Insurance will be applicable and capitalised onto the base loan amount'. Medium confidence — the TMD expresses this as a minimum deposit, not as a maximum LVR, and LMI is capitalised on top of the base loan amount. Separately, Police Bank's First Home Loan is described on the website as supporting 'up to 98% LVR'.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: Derived from the 10% minimum deposit for investment stated in the same target-market bullet. Medium confidence for the same reason as the owner-occupied figure.

lmiCapitalisable.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
lmiCapitalisable.note: 'Lenders Mortgage Insurance will be applicable and capitalised onto the base loan amount'.

maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025 (Variable rate key attributes)
maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.note: 'Interest Only repayments available (Maximum 5 years term).' The Police Bank home loans page states the same maximum.

maxInterestOnlyYearsInvestment.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
maxInterestOnlyYearsInvestment.note: The 5-year maximum IO term is stated under the variable-rate key attributes without distinguishing owner occupied from investment; the product covers both purposes.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
offsetAvailable.note: 'Offset facility, available on Principal & Interest home loans only' — i.e. not on interest-only loans. The home loans page adds that offset is available on variable and P&I fixed loans.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw facility available. On fixed rates, additional repayments are capped at $9,999 per calendar year of the fixed term, with redraw access allowed for those additional repayments. The website states variable-rate redraw up to $50,000.

constructionAvailable.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025
constructionAvailable.note: 'Available for purchase, refinance, home improvements or construction for owner occupier, investment or other personal purposes.'

value: ACT Land Rent Scheme (owner occupied only)
governmentSchemesSupported.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025; Police Bank Home Loans page
governmentSchemesSupported.note: Under the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme, Police Bank can check eligibility for a 5% deposit (2% minimum for single parents or legal guardians) with no LMI. The Land Rent Scheme is an ACT initiative, owner occupied only. Police Bank also markets a dedicated First Home Loan and an Essential Workers Home Loan.

notes.value: MEMBERSHIP IS A HARD KNOCK-OUT. The TMD's key eligibility requirements are: 'An existing, or becoming a member of Police Bank'; 'Be a permanent resident of Australia and 18 years of age or over'; 'Must meet the Bank's credit criteria'. The excluded class of consumers is expressly 'individuals who are not members of Police Bank'. Membership eligibility per the Police Bank home loans page: a current or former member of a State, Territory or Federal police force; a family member of an eligible member; an employee or contractor working in law enforcement or related services; or a member of various partner organisations and government agencies. There is no membership fee.
notes.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025 (product description and excluded class of consumers); membership criteria from https://www.policebank.com.au/loans/home-loans
notes.note: The Police Value product is narrower still — designed for 'current or retired employees who are members of an Australian Police Force or Police organisation uniformed or civilian'.

value.conditions: Must be a member of Police Bank and 18 years of age or over.
The TMD's key eligibility requirement is 'Be a permanent resident of Australia and 18 years of age or over'.
Excluded by the requirement to be a permanent resident of Australia.

rules.sourceTitle: Police Bank TMD — Goldrate Home Loan, effective 31 October 2025 (key eligibility requirements)
rules.note: The temporary-visa exclusions are read directly off the stated permanent-residency requirement rather than from a separate visa policy.

gaps: DIRECT-ONLY LENDER — DO NOT PUT ON A BROKER PANEL. The Goldrate Home Loan TMD (effective 31 October 2025) lists the distribution channels as: 'Online through the Bank's Website', 'In-store retail branch network' and 'Relationship Banking Team'. Mortgage brokers and third-party distributors are NOT listed. No broker portal, broker accreditation page or broker policy document exists on policebank.com.au. Status is therefore 'research_only'.

MEMBERSHIP KNOCK-OUT: membership is restricted to current or former police (State, Territory or Federal), their family members, employees or contractors in law enforcement and related services, and members of partner organisations/government agencies. Non-members are an expressly excluded class of consumers.
No credit policy is published. There is no public servicing buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, income-type shading, employment tenure, credit-history or security policy.
Maximum LVR figures are inferred from the TMD's stated minimum deposits (5% owner occupied / 10% investment) rather than stated as LVR caps — recorded at medium confidence.
The website states the First Home Loan supports 'up to 98% LVR'; the underlying product TMD for that loan (PBL29, effective 31 October 2025) was not read.
Minimum and maximum loan amounts, maximum loan term and maximum age at maturity are not published.

Police Bank markets an Essential Workers Home Loan and an overtime-friendly assessment for police pay and allowances ('they understand police pay and allowances, such as overtime, and consider these when you apply'), but no shading percentage is published.
